summary: Frontend-only testing of the American English Speaking Coach prototype. Verified Dashboard, all 6 scenario cards, full 5-turn Job Interview mic flow (recording -> ~2.5s Transcribing -> auto-filled input -> Send -> feedback -> next question -> session-complete), typed-input alternative on Restaurant scenario, Progress page (chart + 6 recent sessions + today's-goal increment from 0 to 1 after completing session), Settings page coming-soon. All data-testid selectors present as specified. Nav testids use lowercase (nav-coach, nav-practice, ...). No app console errors detected; only benign third-party recharts XAxis/YAxis defaultProps deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Recharts emits React defaultProps deprecation warnings for XAxis/YAxis. Non-blocking; consider upgrading recharts or migrating to JS default params when convenient.
SpeakingButton uses a fixed 2500ms setTimeout for STT simulation — acceptable for mock but document the SEAM (already noted in code comment).
seed_data_creation: None. mockSessions in data/mockData.ts already provides the 6 pre-existing sessions used by the Progress page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All key flows working. Nav data-testids are lowercase (nav-coach/practice/progress/settings). HashRouter — navigate via {BASE}/#/practice/<id>. SpeakingButton -> click once to start recording, click same button again to stop; then wait for response-input value to populate (~2.5s) before clicking send. Job-interview script has exactly 5 turns; after 5th send the session-complete banner appears. Today's-goal counter is in-memory (AppContext), increments after any session (verified 0 -> 1).
